limits.en: Up to 250 contacts, 500 emails/month (max 250/day), 1 audience, 1 seat, limited templates, no scheduling.

keyLimits.en: 3 seats, 3 audiences, up to 4-step automation flows, email scheduling, A/B testing, limited reporting, no dynamic content. Price scales with contact count.
5 seats, 5 audiences, up to 200-step automations, advanced segmentation, SMS add-on, basic dynamic content.
Unlimited seats and unlimited contacts (custom pricing beyond 250,000 contacts), advanced automations with branching, predictive segmentation, priority phone support.

addOns.en: SMS marketing add-on available on Standard and Premium plans.

cautions.en: Listed monthly prices are entry-tier for the smallest contact count; price rises with list size and a promotional discount (around 15% for the first 12 months) applies to the displayed prices, so renewal price is higher.

capabilities.en: Email campaign creation with templates, forms, landing pages, and marketing automation flows.
Audience segmentation, A/B testing, and reporting/analytics on campaign performance.
Predictive segmentation and advanced branching automations on higher tiers.

limitations.en: Free and Essentials plans restrict number of audiences and automation steps, and lack dynamic content.
Pricing scales with contact list size, so cost grows significantly as a list grows even on the same plan tier.

reason.en: Direct competitor with a more generous free tier and transactional email features.

missingAlternatives.name: ConvertKit (Kit)
missingAlternatives.reason: Creator-focused email marketing alternative with simpler automation, not in the catalogue under that slug

unknowns: Exact annualPerMonth discounted price was not isolated from the displayed introductory discount on this page.
Whether tax is included depends on billing region; not stated.
